name: np_siren_wail
character: The first cruiser: a police siren in wail, a slow sweep between 600 and 1400 Hz at 20 cycles a minute with six harmonics; it starts far at the kerb, then closes in behind the cars and stops when the chase is lost.
note: 600-1400 Hz sits inside the 500-1800 Hz band the first project cited for SAE J1849; 20 cycles a minute is the NIJ example for a wail. ESTIMATE: sweep limits, six harmonics and levels are starting values
